keyVerseDR: "The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few." (Lk 10:2)

level1.title: Jesus Sends 72
level1.story: Jesus sent 72 disciples ahead of Him two by two. He said, "Say, 'Peace to this house!'" They came back with joy.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How many helpers did Jesus send?
level1.prayer: Jesus, make me Your helper. Amen.

activity.title: Pray for helpers
activity.intro: Pray for workers in God's harvest.

level2.title: The Seventy-Two
level2.story: Jesus appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him into every city. He said, "The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few. Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest." He told them, "Into whatever house you enter, first say: Peace be to this house." They were to heal the sick and say, "The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you." The seventy-two came back with joy, and Jesus said, "Rejoice in this, that your names are written in heaven."
level2.keyLine: The harvest indeed is great, but the labourers are few.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus send them in pairs?
Why rejoice that our names are in heaven?
level2.prayer: Lord of the harvest, send laborers. Amen.
